title: AI Cleaner - Phone Cleaner
summary: AI-powered phone cleaner to clean up storage, junk and delete duplicate photos
description:
✨ Clean Up Your Phone

Phone storage full again? With AI Cleaner, you can clean up gigabytes of storage space and keep your phone organized in just a few taps.

Delete duplicate photos and similar videos that take up valuable space, remove thousands of emails from your inbox, and compress media files while preserving quality.

All-in-One Phone Cleaner

🧹 ​Smart Storage Cleaner
• With this phone cleaner, you won’t need to manually clean up your phone storage—let the app do the work for you
• Keep your camera roll cleaner with the duplicate and similar photos cleanup feature
• Clean your email inbox by removing unwanted emails and unsubscribing from spam email lists
• Detect and merge duplicate contacts, and delete contacts you no longer need

📷 ​​Photos Cleaner
• Easily delete duplicate photos with a single tap
• Remove old, blurry, or poor-quality photos
• Compress photos to save space without sacrificing quality
• Clean up storage space without losing precious memories

​📩​ Email Cleaner
• Clean your Gmail inbox by quickly removing spam, newsletters, promotions, and unwanted emails
• Unsubscribe from email lists you no longer need to reduce inbox clutter and distractions
• Delete old or unnecessary emails in bulk to keep your mailbox clean and organized
• Check if your email address has been exposed in known data breaches and take action to protect your accounts

✂️ Photo and Video Compressor
• Use the photo compressor to reduce photo size and clean up storage without sacrificing quality
• Compress videos with the video compressor to save space and keep your gallery storage-friendly
• Easily reclaim storage by making the photo and video compressor part of your phone cleanup routine

🔐 ​Secure Vault
• Hide photos, videos, and contacts in a private gallery vault for maximum security
• Easily access your private vault whenever you need to, keeping your sensitive files secure and organized

📲 ​App Manager
• Use the app manager to easily spot apps you haven’t used in a long time
• See exactly how much storage space each app takes on your device
• Uninstall unused apps directly to clean up valuable storage space using the built-in uninstaller

📞 ​Duplicate Contacts Remover
• Use the contacts cleaner to keep only the most relevant and up-to-date contacts
• Merge duplicate numbers into one contact to keep your address book organized
• Delete incomplete contacts to clear up your contacts list

🗓️​ Past Events Remover
• Clean up storage space on your calendar by deleting past events that clutter your schedule

AI Cleaner - Key Features:

✅ Memory Cleaner
✅ Smart Storage Cleaner
✅ Camera Roll Cleaner
✅ Email Cleaner
✅ Photo & Video Compressor
✅ Private Storage Vault
✅ App Manager
✅ Contacts Cleaner
✅ Past Events Remover

❓ ​FAQ
Q: How do I clean my phone storage?
A: AI Cleaner helps you free up storage by removing duplicate and similar photos or videos, compressing large media files, and merging duplicate or outdated contacts.

Q: How do I find duplicate or similar photos on my phone?
A: You don’t need to search for them one by one. AI Cleaner automatically scans your gallery and detects duplicate and similar photos so you can remove them quickly.

Q: How can I reduce video file size?
A: AI Cleaner includes a video compressor that allows you to select the compression quality. Your video is compressed to reduce its size while keeping high visual quality.
